ENGINEERED TO LAST

Ground-Up Construction. Zero Compromise.

A great garden relies entirely on what sits beneath the surface. We do not just roll out turf and lay slabs; we engineer the entire outdoor space. From substantial site clearance and deep excavation to correct drainage layouts and load-bearing sub-bases, our builds are physically structurally sound.

Every project we undertake is built completely in-house by our own team. We manage the structural masonry, precision brickwork, custom timber framing, and porcelain paving from day one until handover.

We do not rush ground preparation, and we do not cut corners on material specifications. We build gardens designed to handle the British weather and remain perfectly level for decades.

Our Process

01

Site Survey & Brief

We visit your property to assess the ground conditions, check levels, analyze drainage requirements, and map out your structural layout goals.

02

Master Planning & Spec

We engineer a comprehensive master plan, mapping out the precise materials, structural brickwork details, and structural sub-base depths required.

03

Fixed Itemized Estimate

You receive a fully transparent, cost estimate. No hidden fees, no guesswork—clear pricing and timelines from the start.

04

In-House Groundworks

Our team handles the entire build. We manage the deep excavation, drainage installations, heavy brickwork, and precision masonry entirely in-house.

05

Final Sign-Off & Handover

We conduct a final structural walk-through with you to inspect levels, clean the site completely, and formally sign off on your new outdoor space.
